children.label: a
children.prompt: The width is $x$ cm. Find the length of the rectangle in terms of $x$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: The rectangle is extended by $5$ cm to form a square. Form a quadratic equation and find $x$.

answer.worked:
The square has equal sides, so its length equals $x+5$ cm.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{50}{x}&=x+5\\50&=x(x+5)\\x^2+5x-50&=0\\(x+10)(x-5)&=0\\x&=-10\text{ or }x=5.\end{align*}$$
Reject $x=-10$ because a width must be positive. Hence $x=5\text{ cm}$. The original length is $50\div5=10$ cm, equal to the extended width $5+5=10$ cm.
